guildTitle: Welcome guys to join the guild [2n]
quickHtml:
The guild has a WPS Cloud Document for recording member information, along with other features. Click here to access it.

We have achieved automatic calculation of TP points through tiering, automatic counting of owned Super petals, cell member addition permissions (requiring the addition of flowerwsr as a contact in WPS), and even automatic leaderboard updates.

Although the Mark List is not commonly used, it does not mean we lack it—it's a matter of whether the guild's prestige is significant.

Several quick links were also inserted into the table cells, such as DPS calculation and viewing the Surviving Super creatures.

Add the guild leader's WeChat: Zjk-1332 (Available during weekends) To quickly join the guild group chat!
